task: L1->L2 priority-transaction census across ZKsync Elastic Network chains

T.note: UTC, end exclusive; window end is in the future relative to the run, so effective end = scan time 2026-08-25 ~15:20Z

eth_block_bounds: 25832861-25833013 (per-chain, resolved at scan start; see raw/<chain>.jsonl.runlog start events)

post_scan_tooling: results/scripts/rescan_gaps.py (gap recovery via multi-endpoint L1 union rescan)
results/scripts/check_completeness.py (continuity, dual boundary proofs, L2 spot checks)

ethereum_l1.https://eth.drpc.org: package-verified; used by initial scans. FINDING: free tier silently omitted 29 NewPriorityRequest events (sophon 11, zero 6, lens 12) in blocks ~23.575M-23.595M while returning success; also item-level batch throttling. All losses detected via txId continuity and recovered.
ethereum_l1.https://rpc.mevblocker.io: package-verified; primary workhorse (era full rescan, batches of 50 reliable)
ethereum_l1.https://eth.api.onfinality.io/public: ADDED at runtime: getLogs 10k OK with blockTimestamp; used for era + gap rescans; no historical eth_call, batch rate-limited
ethereum_l1.https://gateway.tenderly.co/public/mainn: ADDED at runtime: getLogs 10k OK (no blockTimestamp -> 13 openzk ts backfilled), historical eth_call OK (window-start boundary proofs); used for openzk scan + gap rescans

endpoints.l2_rpcs: all 8 package RPCs, verified via eth_chainId at preflight; no substitutions needed
explorers_and_dbs: github.com raw (aave-address-book, zklink docs, sophon-org/custom-usdc-bridge), docs.zklink.io, web search for protocol docs

rpc_call_accounting_approx.eth_getTransactionByHash: 45,711 tx lookups in ~950 batch requests (50/req) + solo retries
rpc_call_accounting_approx.eth_getCode: ~19,000 lookups in ~250 batch requests (initiator classification incl. EIP-7702 code-prefix pass)
rpc_call_accounting_approx.l2_rpc_calls: ~130 (96 spot checks, chainIds, proxy impl slots, bytecode)

deviations_from_package: Two Ethereum endpoints added (onfinality, tenderly) after measuring drpc throttling/data loss; recorded above and in REPORT.md §2.
Era scan was killed and resumed twice (checkpoint-native) to repoint endpoints: run.log/run2.log/run3.log all preserved.

Gap records were recovered from L1 (not L2): they carry full l1_from/l1_to provenance and 'source':'gap-rescan' instead of the spec's 'l2-recovery' shape; OUTPUT_SPEC's gap_handling enum extended to 'recovered-from-l1-rescan' accordingly (better fidelity than the spec's fallback).
Extra folder results/scripts/ with run tooling + attribution.json/labels.json/completeness.json/codecache.json/initiator-kinds.json for reproducibility.

deposit_by_contract refined beyond spec: EIP-7702-delegated EOAs are counted as users (deposit_via_7702 field), not protocol contracts; enriched schema gains deposit_via_7702, aggregates gain deposits_via_7702_accounts and a three-way initiator split.
Package discrepancy found and reported: 3 Sophon native-SOPH deposits executed AFTER the 2026-06-25 deposit block (last: 2026-07-03); package expected zero.
